headline: BLACK IS
NOT
'DUE'.

scenes.say: Five reds in a row. Black is 'due'. Your gut is lying to you.
The gambler's fallacy: believing randomness evens itself out in the short run.
Code flips a fair fifty-fifty {n} times and finds every streak of {k} in a row.
There are {cases} streaks like that. The next spin switches colour {flip} of the time.
The wheel has no memory. Every spin is new, and it owes nobody anything.
When events are independent, the past never sends the future a bill.

takeaway: When events are independent, the past never sends the future a bill.
